_doc: Two-turn experiment on the paper's example photos (multiturn/paper_photos_plan.md). turn1 = the paper's own CSV, unchanged. prompts = SAM2 clicks on the turn-1 input image, TOP-LEFT px (832x480). turn2 = direct force on a tracked object; the force point is that object's centroid in the turn-1 last frame. turn2_fallback: used in order when the turn2 target is not visible in the turn-1 last frame (recorded in t2_choice.json). turn2b (11/27): collision / push-again version of turn 2; angle may be 'toward:<obj>' / 'toward:nearest' / 'toward:center' (direction from the target's turn-1-end centroid). turn2b force per scene (11/27): 100 for single objects and close chess pieces, 120 balls, 150 when the other object is far (cantaloupes, pendulum), bulb kept at 200 (moved only 3 px at 200). 11/27 12:30: added ballthendominos (dominoes photo, previously run 11/25 as exp8/exp10 with turn-2 force 350); turn2b = push a standing back-row domino to the right (force 100) so the other dominoes fall (user request 11/27 12:40). 11/27 13:00 turn2c (user: follow the paper's causality): GOAL mode like every paper example. projectile = the object/agent that causes the motion (its centroid is the CSV projectile point), target = the object that must move (goal force on its centroid); projectile == target for hand/paw/foot scenes (agent off-screen, as in the paper). target 'nearest' = nearest visible object to the projectile; angle 'away' = direction projectile -> target; 'toward:center' = target -> image centre. Captions name the cause.
